def factor_volume_instability_smoothed_range_gate(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    vol_mean = df_copy['volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_std = df_copy['volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    cv = vol_std / vol_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    cv = cv.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    range_ratio = (df_copy['high'] - df_copy['low']) / df_copy['close'].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    range_stability = -range_ratio.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    range_stability_smooth = range_stability.ewm(span=5, adjust=False).mean()
    weight = 1.0 + 0.5 * np.tanh(range_stability_smooth)
    df_copy['factor_volume_instability_smoothed_range_gate'] = cv * weight
    return df_copy['factor_volume_instability_smoothed_range_gate']
